title: Director Global Business Development
description:
On behalf of our client BONESUPPORT (Nasdaq Stockholm: BONEX) — a fast-growing innovation-driven international MedTech company — we are seeking a Director Global Business Development to play a key role in shaping the company’s next growth phase. This is a headquarters-based position located in Lund. You are based in the Öresund region.
BONESUPPORT develops and commercializes injectable bioceramic bone graft substitutes (CERAMENT®), addressing a critical unmet need in orthopedic surgery.
WHAT BONESUPPORT CAN OFFER
This is a unique opportunity to step into a newly created role within an organizational structure designed to support the company’s continued growth and evolution. Since embarking on the commercialization journey, BONESUPPORT has now entered a new phase - characterized by strong momentum, high growth, and an increasingly dynamic business environment.
Operating at a fast pace, the organization combines entrepreneurial energy with a solid structural foundation. Recent organizational changes have sharpened the focus on strategic upstream marketing , while commercial execution is fully integrated and scaled.
THE ROLE
This newly established role is designed to fuel growth by proactively identifying, shaping, and advancing high-impact business opportunities into clear, decision-ready proposals, leveraging sharp market insight, analytics, and commercial acumen.
You will drive cross-functional alignment and bring structure and momentum to innovation and portfolio prioritization, ensuring the right strategic choices are made and executed.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Business Development & Opportunity Assessment
·       Lead identification, qualification, and evaluation of new business opportunities.
-Partnerships, product extensions, new markets
·       Engage external stakeholders to validate opportunities and support early partnerships.
Global Market Research & Trend Intelligence
·       Conduct global market research to identify growth potential.
·       Track emerging clinical, technological, and industry trends relevant to Medtech.
Tools, Methods & Governance Compliance
·       Ensure consistent use of analytic and research tools (Power BI, Tableau, SQL, CRM/ERP sources).
Facilitate Advanced Data Analytics & Insights
·       Ensure data quality, transparency, and compliance.
·       Continuously improve BD processes, templates, and decision frameworks.
Strategic Planning & Portfolio Prioritization
·       Partner with leadership on growth strategy and opportunity roadmaps.
Cross‑Functional Leadership
·       Coordinate cross-functional alignment
·       Align data, assumptions, and resources.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
You bring strong business acumen combined with a strategic, holistic mindset and a solid understanding of MedTech product development. With a proven ability to collaborate across functions and align stakeholders, you operate with senior presence and confidence. Your approach is highly analytical and data-driven, supported by advanced skills in Excel and relevant tools. You have demonstrated success in driving change within complex, matrix organizations and are experienced in developing and presenting robust, end-to-end business cases.

title: Medical Consultant (MD)
description:

Geography : You can live in The Nordic region (Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland).
Responsibilities

-Lead medical planning and drive medical activities with a long-term perspective.

-Facilitate the dialogue during the meeting.
-Present data relevant to the Company product and ability to discuss data.

title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
Chief Operating Officer based in the Stockholm area
A fast-growing Swedish pharmaceutical company is seeking a Chief Operating Officer with experience from the pharmaceutical industry to support continued growth and portfolio expansion. The company has built a portfolio across multiple therapeutic areas and operates in the Nordics and Baltics. The next phase includes further geographic expansion and portfolio development.
The Position
The COO ensures effective value realization after agreements are signed. You will own the end-to-end process from signed agreement to stable commercial operations. It includes portfolio prioritization together with Commercial and Business Development. It also includes supplier strategy and relationships with CMOs, CDMOs, and licensing partners. The COO coordinates cross-functional execution for launches and major changes.
Key priorities are to reduce time-to-market, strengthen commercial execution, improve supplier management, sharpen portfolio focus, and increase predictability of revenues and launches.
The position reports to the CEO and is part of the Executive Management Team. There is no direct line management responsibility.
Your profile
We are looking for a professional with international experience in go-to-market execution, value realization, and resource prioritization. Experience from smaller or mid-sized pharmaceutical company is preferred. Experience with in-licensed and internally developed products is required. You must be able to lead without formal line responsibility. Strong analytical skills, governance experience, and sound commercial and operational judgment are essential.

title: Area Sales Manager, Stockholm
description:
Till vår kund ewimed – en specialist som gör verklig skillnad inom dränagebehandling med fokus på trygghet och livskvalitet – söker vi nu en engagerad och driven Area Sales Manager, Stockholm.
VAD KAN EWIMED ERBJUDA?
Om du trivs i en roll där du arbetar nära kunden och tillbringar större delen av din tid ute på fältet är detta en miljö som passar dig. Du kommer att ansvara för dränageprodukter som är dominerande på marknaden, präglas av hög patientnöjdhet och ger omedelbar lindring för patienter när de behöver det som mest. Här får du arbeta i ett högt tempo, ta egna initiativ och driva dina affärsmöjligheter framåt genom tät och kvalitativ kundkontakt. På ewimed blir du en del av ett sammanhang där du arbetar självständigt men samtidigt känner en tydlig samhörighet med det svenska teamet och kollegorna i Skandinavien.
Unikt koncept – Stöd genom hela behandlingsresan
ewimed arbetar med ett helhetskoncept som inkluderar workshops och utbildning för läkare, närvaro vid operationer, utbildning på sjukhusens avdelningar och i hemsjukvården samt stöd till patienter och anhöriga – allt för att skapa trygghet, höja livskvaliteten och ge patienter mer tid med sina närmaste. I praktiken innebär detta att ewimed planerar insatser redan vid utskrivning, utbildar vårdpersonal och patienter löpande, samarbetar nära sjukhusens team kring materialbeställningar och alltid säkerställer att nödvändigt dränagematerial finns tillgängligt vid hemgång.
FÖRETAGET
ewimed är ett familjeägt företag, grundat 1991 i Tyskland, som sedan dess vuxit till en etablerad medicinteknisk aktör och Europas största leverantör inom sitt område. ewimed stödjer hundratals kliniker och sjukhus runt om i Europa med produkter och lösningar inom specialistområden såsom thoraxkirurgi, pneumologi, gastroenterologi, onkologi, visceral kirurgi, gynekologi, radiologi och kardiologi, med fokus på dränage av pleuravätska (vätska i lungorna) och ascites (vätska i buken).
ROLLEN – AREA SALES MANAGER
Rollbeskrivning
Som Area Sales Manager hos ewimed, med distrikt Stockholm, blir du en viktig drivkraft i företagets fortsatta tillväxt på den svenska marknaden. I nära samarbete med Sales Director, Scandinavia och övriga kollegor i den Skandinaviska organisationen får du ansvar för att stärka och utveckla ewimeds produktportfölj. Rollen innebär ett betydande eget ansvar men också en stark gemenskap inom organisationen, där kunder, budgetar och resultat hanteras tillsammans med kollegorna i Skandinavien. Du arbetar nära instruktionssjuksköterskorna, men har inget direkt personalansvar.
KOMPETENSER OCH ERFARENHETER
Du är en säljare som snabbt skapar förtroende och bygger goda relationer med kunder och som med samma lätthet sätter dig in i ewimeds produkter, arbetssätt och patientgrupper. Du arbetar självständigt och proaktivt och tar initiativ i kunddialoger. Med din kombination av säljdriv, lyhördhet och närvaro presenterar du företagets produkter och tjänster på ett tydligt, respektfullt och relevant sätt för varje mottagare.
Det finns olika erfarenheter som kan göra dig rätt för rollen som Area Sales Manager på ewimed. Du kan ha några års försäljningserfarenhet inom medicinteknik och god förståelse för upphandlingsprocesser, eller komma från vården med viljan att ta steget in i en roll som förenar klinisk förståelse med kommersiellt fokus och affärsmässig skärpa. Rollen kräver också att du känner dig trygg i att prata och skriva på engelska i det dagliga arbetet.
Låter detta intressant? Varm välkommen att skicka in din ansökan.
Vid frågor får du gärna kontakta oss på Brice Group;

title: Medical Science Manager, Nordics
description:
On behalf of our customer – an international pharmaceutical company – we are looking for an interim Medical Science Manager , Nordics, to be part of an upcoming Nordic product launch and actively contribute to its medical success.
Period : 12 months with the possibility of extension
Location : Nordic region
THE ROLE
This is a field-based Nordic medical role with responsibility for medical activities connected to a new product launch. The position has a broad Nordic scope and plays a key role in scientific engagement, launch preparation, and ongoing medical support across the region. The role is highly operational and requires strong presence in the field, combined with close collaboration with Nordic commercial and medical teams.
RESPONSIBILITIES
-Build, develop, and maintain long-term relationships with key opinion leaders across the Nordic region.
-Contribute to the development, review, and medical approval of scientific and educational materials.
-Plan and execute Nordic advisory boards and other scientific exchange initiatives.
-Deliver medical training and educational activities for internal and external stakeholders
-Act as a scientific partner to the commercial organization, providing medical input and field insights.
-Support launch-related medical activities in close Nordic collaboration.
COMPETENCE REQUIREMENT AND ABILITIES
-Experience from a Medical Science Liaison and/or Medical Advisor role.
-Proven experience with Nordic-level responsibility is required.
-Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
-Ability to work independently in a field-based role with a proactive mindset.
-Strong relationship-building skills and experience interacting with senior scientific stakeholders.
